diagnosis.finding: Joint and single-method pass rates on I4/I5 decline toward zero as budget grows - the signature of a systematic bias, not sampling noise. Cause: nerfacto/bionerf coverage is regime-skewed (I4 retention by regime: 63/68/68/97/71/96 percent), so the balanced generator's equal-per-regime allocation converges to the equal-weight regime mean, which on I4 sits -1.2904 dB (PSNR), -0.0302 (SSIM), +0.0419 (LPIPS) from the I4 population mean - each several times the corresponding tolerance.
diagnosis.interpretation: E8 as run is a population-shift stress test, and the audit correctly refuses to certify: with incomplete, non-randomly missing method coverage, no balanced subset can match the intersection references. It is NOT evidence against the E1 result, whose intersection retains 96-99 percent per regime.
